entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hm? Your bag seems awfully full.
entries.uk: Гм? Щось сумка в тебе геть напхана.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Do I need to do an inspection?
Sure thing.
Please ignore this.
Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I was just joking.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, you can go.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What a stupid thing to say.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, just hurry up and get moving.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's my job to worry about this stuff.[n]It was just a joke though.
entries.uk: Перейматися таким — моя робота.[n]Але то був просто жарт.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, you can go.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, by the way... is there anything[n]you need?
Weapons, armor...
I'm all set.
Are you buying?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If that's supposed to make me laugh,[n]it won't work.
entries.uk: Якщо це мало мене розсмішити,[n]то не вийшло.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, that's what I'd expect a kid your age[n]to say.
entries.uk: Ага, чогось такого я й чекав[n]від малого твого віку.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't be ridiculous.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Back when I was young, I had to work[n]to get what I wanted. I think you should[n]do the same.
entries.uk: Замолоду я мусив працювати, щоб мати те,[n]чого хотів. Гадаю, і тобі варто[n]так само.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: On that note, I think I saw some [clr 2]part-time[n]job magazines[clr 27] down at [clr 2]Shibuya Station[clr 27].
entries.uk: До речі, я наче бачив [clr 2]журнали[n]з підробітками[clr 27] на [clr 2]станції Шібуя[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If I remember correctly, they were [clr 2]near[n]the ticket gates[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: After all, I can't have you depending on[n]me for allowance.
entries.uk: Зрештою, не вистачало ще, щоб ти[n]клянчив у мене кишенькові.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now come on, get going.
